authorization: 2026-10-20 用户：我们先做你说的可预测问题；学习什么时候不启动补查
scope: Offline feasibility of predicting decision-invariant completion. Not prediction of harmful whole-week effects; no simulator calls, new RL, controller changes or deployment.

primary_label.skip_equivalent_1: The exact float32/tie-broken chosen representative ID after original local completion equals the chosen ID before completion
primary_label.retain_0: Completion changes chosen representative ID; its economic value is unknown, so retain rather than label it good
primary_label.eligibility: Only original FRAME calls with completion_budget > 0
primary_label.properties: Label 1 proves the same returned search action at that saved state under unchanged selection. It does not prove model predictions or off-trajectory decisions are correct.
primary_label.forbidden_labels: Never assign a whole-week cost sign to every call in that week; never call any reward-improving candidate a beneficial whole-week action

feature_scope: Only outcomes revealed before completion, public candidate order and alias-aware station memberships. No station/candidate identity, date, call number, future/full-pool labels, completion feedback, measured cost or total runtime as features. Missing score uses 0.5 plus a flag; absent reward gap/gain uses 0.
fit_weights: Equal total weight per training calendar date; per-call weights normalized to mean 1. No class rebalance or selected seed.

evaluation.grouped_oof: Leave one calendar date YYYY-MM-DD out. G1/G2 generated seeds for that date always withheld together. All eligible dates included; no random call split.
evaluation.cohort_transfer: Fit once on all eligible old13 calls, evaluate all eligible G1+G2 calls; both generated groups exposed historical data, not sealed new generalization
evaluation.decision: Skip only if predicted P(exact same choice) >= threshold; report both fixed thresholds for both fixed models without selecting a winner or threshold
metrics: reward loss and named missed states
evaluation.decision_rule: Exploratory conservative signal exists only if the same fixed model at 0.95 produces at least one skip and zero missed choice changes in BOTH grouped OOF and cohort transfer; otherwise no demonstrated conservative skip signal. Even passing is not a safe deployment or closed-loop qualification.

limits: Exactly two fixed model families. No hyperparameter search, feature selection, threshold sweep, new model after results, or final all-data deployment model. Preserve all fits, prediction errors and adverse cases. No new broad generalization or speed claim.
